description:
`dev/simulation_results/` and `dev/studies/` are operational inputs read by gf2-sim code and tests. Their loose narrative Markdown moves to owner directories or the legacy mirror while every consumed file stays in place.

## Background

Code and test consumers are listed in `dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` §3.1 and §0 finding 4.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No narrative Markdown that no code, test or campaign reads remains in `dev/simulation_results/` or `dev/studies/`; files read through dataset paths, `include_bytes!`, campaign configs or tests are unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: Moved notes owned by open epics live under their epic's `dev/active/` directory and are linked; notes owned by terminal epics live in their archive directories; unowned notes live in the legacy mirror.
- [hard] REQ-03: Citations of moved notes are repointed, a link scan of the touched files reports no unresolved local link, and the Rust CI gate passes.
- [hard] REQ-04: The manifest records each row as complete.
title: Relocate loose narrative Markdown out of simulation_results and studies
